activity.notes: Naser al-Din Shah Qajar succeeded Mohammad Shah in 1848 and ruled Qajar Iran until his assassination on 1 May 1896. ATLAS keeps the accession boundary at year granularity because the exact accession/coronation sequence is represented inconsistently across modern summaries, while the reign years 1848–1896 and death date are secure.

sources.title: Chronology of Iranian History Part 2 — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica records Mohammad Shah's death and the accession of Naser al-Din Shah in 1848.
